move: grid of tiles shrinks away to reveal a card, then closes
how: A 32x18 grid of 40px tile divs in alternating off-white shades covers an editorial card (photo, eyebrow, headline, copy, buttons). From 0.025 D each tile scales to 0 with expo.in over 0.42s, ordered by distance from a point near the photo plus jitter (spread over 1.5s), so the card is uncovered in a speckled radial pixel wipe; from 0.65 D tiles scale back to 1 with expo.out from the opposite corner, and once closed the tiles breathe 0.92 briefly. Under the mask the photo pans, the headline, copy and row slide up on reveal, and the card drifts up 20px before it is hidden.
adapt: Replace the card content and photo, the tile colours (match the stage background) and the reveal and hide origin points; cell size sets the pixel scale. Keep the 0.42s expo tile pops and the 1.5s spread so the wipe travels.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the card and appends the 576 tile divs with seeded orders; animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline with reveal at 0.025 D + ord*0.25 D and hide at 0.65 D + ord*0.25 D, from() tweens keeping immediateRender:false, selectors scoped to el. The grid is fixed at 1280x720; derive columns and rows from the shot size.
caveats: 1728 tweens on 576 DOM elements; heavy timeline
the closing breathe tweens run slightly past D
